turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero in my son's gradebook before anyone picked up a phone and called me?
That's not an answer. Did you decide, or did someone above you? Before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me, Hale. If his reading level is years ahead of the class, then why is there a zero next to his name? You still haven't told me who entered it, or when.
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Then why are we here? Compliments aren't evidence, and I've stopped listening to them. Either you have something with a date on it, or the zero comes off today.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.

"My way." Your way put a zero in front of his whole class before anyone called me, so no, you don't get my blessing. Show me what you have, or I'm walking down to the principal's office when we're done here.
